about_short_description.short_description: Modern credit risk management software for builders', plumber, and timber merchants.

product.name: Credit Risk Management Software
product.description: Software that combines company-wide intelligence to provide real-time credit scoring and risk predictions for customers in the building supply sector.

product.name: Automated Credit Approvals
product.description: A service that automates customer background checks, reference collection, and credit approval decisions within minutes.

product.name: Customer Intelligence Capture
product.description: A tool that gathers and analyzes updates from customer-facing teams to provide current insights on customer credit risk.

product.name: Anomaly Detection and 24/7 Credit Monitoring
product.description: An AI-driven system that continuously monitors customer transactions and public data to detect unusual behavior indicating credit risk.
